ValidationRule.description: An internal NF deal cannot be funded if the approval expiration date has already passed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (Approval_Expiration_Date__c < TODAY()) && (ISCHANGED(StageName)|| (Approval_Expiration_Date__c < DATEVALUE(Fund_Date__c)&& ISCHANGED(Fund_Date__c)))&& ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Funded") && ((Lender_Account__r.Name = 'National Funding - Diamond WC Funding')|| (Lender_Account__r.Name = 'National Funding - Platinum WC Funding')|| (Lender_Account__r.Name = 'National Funding - Gold WC Funding')|| (Lender_Account__r.Name = 'National Funding - Internal Lease Lender Record')|| (Lender_Account__r.Name = 'National Funding - Commercial WC Funding'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A deal's Stage cannot be marked as 'Funded' if the approval expiration date has already passed.
